build_text_to_speech_task: build a TextToSpeechTask to configure and run text-to-speech training with speaker embeddings and vocoder support
build_speech_generator: build an AutoRegressiveSpeechGenerator or NonAutoregressiveSpeechGenerator for synthesizing speech waveforms from text input
compute_mel_cepstral_distortion: compute batch mel cepstral distortion between predicted and target waveforms using DTW alignment
run_dynamic_time_warping: run batched dynamic time warping on a distance matrix to compute optimal alignment paths
plot_tts_output: plot text-to-speech output spectrograms and alignment matrices for TensorBoard visualization
